Summary
: An English study of the Malatimadhava by Bhavabhuti:—A Prakarana type of Drama in ten acts. The main story revolves around the love of Malati (daughter of Bhurivasu—minister of Padmāvatī) and Madhava (son of Devarata—minister of the king of Vidarbha).
This study discusses the life and history of the author, as well as the literary, social, religious, historical and cultural aspects of the Malatimadhava.
Other titles: Mālatīmādhava (मालतीमाधव), Bhavabhūti (भवभूति).
